blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: For a quick and easy protein shake, add 1/4 cup Whey Protein Powder to a glass of juice or milk. Mix and enjoy.

To make a delicious smoothie, blend 1/4 cup Whey Protein Powder with 1 cup fresh or frozen fruit, 1/2 cup milk or water, sweetener if desired, and a handful of ice (about 1/2 cup). Makes about 2 cups.
These are a few of our favorite shakes and smoothies: just combine all the ingredients in a blender. Fruit can be fresh or frozen!

blocks.label: Warnings
